title: Circuit Query Membership Characterization
statement: Let $F$ be a family of Boolean circuits such that every circuit in the family is well formed and has fan-in at most two, and let $q$ be a bit string. The encoding of the circuit in the family for inputs of length $|q|$, paired with $q$, belongs to the language of satisfiable circuit encodings if and only if that circuit accepts $q$.
hypotheses_covered: Every circuit in the family is well formed and has fan-in at most two
The query $q$ is a bit string
